_about: What NPCs say (AUD-03 for townsfolk), generated in each designed voice by tools/voice/npc_lines.py.
roles: who says what. Each voice in a role gets every line of that role, saved as
assets/audio/vo/<voice>/<event>_<n>.mp3. The game plays a random one for the event (data/audio/sfx.json):
greet when Rowan walks up to them, startled when he swings or casts close by.
Keep lines short and in the generic-fantasy register; no names from the Dreamlands (see dialogue/bible.md).

greet: Morning. Mind the mud by the well, it's deeper than it looks.
You're Oswin's lad, aren't you? Give him my regards.
Fine day for it. Shame about the wolves.
Heard there's goblins up past the east fields again. Watch yourself.
If you're going out the north gate, be back before dark.
Oh! Didn't see you there. Good day to you.
startled: Whoa! Not near me, if you please!

greet: Keep your blade sheathed inside the fence.
Wolves on the east road again. Stay on the paths.
If you see goblins, you come and tell the Watch. Don't play the hero.
startled: Hey! Put that away before someone gets hurt.
Easy there! That's the Watch you're swinging at.
Try that again and you'll spend the night in the stocks.
